| [pkal_filter](#jaxidem.filters.pkal_filter.pkal_filter) | The Temporally Parallel Kalman Filter. |

### pkal_filter { #jaxidem.filters.pkal_filter.pkal_filter }

```python
filters.pkal_filter.pkal_filter(
    m_0,
    P_0,
    M,
    PHI_tree,
    S2_eta,
    S2_eps_tree,
    zs_tree,
    S2_eta_shape,
    S2_eps_shape,
    likelihood='partial',
)
```

The Temporally Parallel Kalman Filter.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                                                                                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Default     |
|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| m_0          | Float\[Array, r\]                                                                       | Prior mean of the filter at T=0.                                                                                                                                                                               | _required_  |
| P_0          | Float\[Array, \'r r\'\]                                                                 | Prior state covariance at T=0.                                                                                                                                                                                 | _required_  |
| M            | Float\[Array, \'r r\'\]                                                                 | State-transition matrix.                                                                                                                                                                                       | _required_  |
| PHI_tree     | Union\[Float\[Array, 1\], Float\[Array, r\], Float\[Array, \'r r\'\]\]                  | Observation matrices for each time step. Each leaf corresponds to a time step and may have a different observation dimension `n`.                                                                              | _required_  |
| S2_eta       | Union\[Float\[Array, 1\], Float\[Array, r\], Float\[Array, \'r r\'\]\]                  | Process noise variance. Can be of shape (1,) (for scalar/i.i.d.), shape (r,) (for uncorrelated noise), or shape (r, r) (for correlated noise).                                                                 | _required_  |
| S2_eps_tree  | PyTree\[Union\[Float\[Array, 1\], Float\[Array, \'?n\'\], Float\[Array, \'?n ?n\'\]\]\] | Observation noise variance for each time step. Each leaf may vary in dimension: shape (1,) for scalar/i.i.d. noise, shape (n,) for uncorrelated noise, or shape (n, n) for correlated noise.                   | _required_  |
| zs_tree      | PyTree\[Float\[Array, n\]\]                                                             | Observed data values. Each leaf corresponds to a time step and may have a different observation dimension `n`.                                                                                                 | _required_  |
| S2_eta_shape | int                                                                                     | Shape code for `S2_eta` (needed for JIT compilation); 0 is scalar/i.i.d., 1 is vector/uncorrelated, 2 is matrix/correlated.                                                                                    | _required_  |
| S2_eps_shape | int                                                                                     | Shape code for each leaf of `S2_eps_tree` (needed for JIT compilation); 0 is scalar/i.i.d., 1 is vector/uncorrelated, 2 is matrix/correlated.                                                                  | _required_  |
| likelihood   | Literal\[\'none\', \'partial\', \'full\'\]                                              | Log-likelihood computation mode. Must be one of 'none' (no likelihood is computed), 'partial' (likelihood computed up to an additive constant), or 'full' (full likelihood is computed). Default is 'partial'. | `'partial'` |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name         | Type           | Description                  |
|--------------|----------------|------------------------------|
| filt_results | PKalmanResults | For details see Notes below. |

#### Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

The return type is PKalmanResults, containing:

    - `ll` : float
      Log-likelihood value (possibly up to an additive constant).

    - `ms` : PyTree[Float[Array, "T r"]]
      Posterior means at each time step.

    - `Ps` : PyTree[Float[Array, "T r r"]]
      Posterior covariance matrices at each time step.

Symbolic dimensions:

    - `r` : state dimension
    - `n` : observation dimension (may vary per time step)
    - `T` : number of time steps
